summary: The filing is an 8-K by Lumen Technologies and subsidiary Qwest Corporation reporting a Support Agreement with noteholders to support a previously announced exchange offer of Qwest's existing notes for new notes. The Supporting Noteholders agreed to tender ~$456 million aggregate principal of Existing 2056 and 2057 Notes. This is a routine debt restructuring/refinancing via exchange offer, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved.
